issue: LM edge-cap selection omits the same internal bigram boundary score later added to surviving paths. Equal LM states can also have different compound-boundary attenuation.
hypotheses: If the missing boundary term drops relevant edges, a lower-frequency seventeenth homophone favored by the unchanged boundary model will be absent before the fix and retained after it.
If selection is keyed only by LM characters, paths ending in one compound word versus single-character edges may reuse incompatible selections; explicit word-boundary state should separate them.
Correcting pruning may expose bad pre-existing scores or additional cost on real input; passing small fixtures alone is insufficient for adoption.
change: Use unchanged boundary evidence before truncation, reuse it during append, and key query-local selection by previous code point plus single-character boundary state. No score constants, dictionary bytes, LM bytes, candidate counts or search budgets change. Legacy/no-LM paths keep existing results.
developmentGate: Actual production M20 on the fixed AISHELL and Tatoeba development sets: each domain top1, top5, recall nondecreasing and character errors nonincreasing. Exact-state gains/losses retained. The new deterministic missing-edge regression must fail before and pass after. No external-data special cases.
regressionGate: If development passes, run the existing full-pinyin/typo progressive workload and host core/service/UI suites, retaining all changed outputs and checking learning, corrections, explicit boundaries and legacy behavior. No additional tuning to the observed corpus.
androidGate: If host quality and regressions pass, use only the dedicated Sense emulator. All fixed confirmation/continuation and lifecycle cases must pass; same-emulator ABBA confirmation median and P95 may increase at most 10 percent. Compare against the E42 fixed Debug baseline, not physical phones or host-only latency.
release: No release until product gates pass. Existing rc.5 remains intact; failed candidates and diagnostics are kept separately rather than silently changing the baseline.
scope: Known development/regression data, not fresh blind accuracy. Fixture edge rescue is a general search-correctness result, not proof of broad semantic quality. Overall quality goal remains active.
